title: Continuity-of-government succession: Harrington was number 16

tellings.quote: preserve the government. I was number 16. I remember cuz my daughter sewed a big 16 on the back of my swimsuit.

plain: In the 1980s the US had secret plans to keep the government running through a disaster such as a nuclear attack, and John S. Herrington, Secretary of Energy under Reagan, says he was number 16 in that line of succession. He tells Michels this from his own experience, as part of the plan to "preserve the government." He says he remembers the number because his daughter sewed a big 16 on the back of his swimsuit.
